memory.name: Desperate Search

memory.dialogue: What were you even looking for?

memory.name: Fixation
memory.description: For the rest of the run: every Deadline will have 7 Rounds, but Rounds will only have 1 Spin (unless any effect changes this number during the Run). Ending a Deadline early will only reward 2 [Tickets] per round skipped.
memory.dialogue: Yeah, you are definitely fixated!

memory.name: Screen Addiction
memory.description: For the rest of the run: Deadlines will only have 1 Round, but you'll be able to pick up to 21 Spins from the start. Rounds will also grant more Tickets [Tickets]. You also start the run with 27 [Coins] and 5 [Tickets].
memory.dialogue: One of many of your problems.

memory.name: Cold Affection
memory.description: You begin with 12 [Tickets]. For the rest of the run you'll earn 0 Tickets [Tickets] at the end of every round (unless any effect changes this number during the run).
memory.dialogue: Yeah, don't open up to me, please!

memory.name: Old Wounds
memory.description: Deadlines are 50% easier but you begin the run with 15 deposited coins only! You cannot upload a score to Leaderboard with this Memory Card.a
memory.dialogue: Many memories, many lives!

memory.name: Bullies' Favorite
memory.description: For the rest of the run, whenever a Deadline ends, if you have 6 or more Charms equipped discard 1 at random, then gain 2 free Restocks at the store.
memory.dialogue: Are you calling me a bully?

memory.name: Delusions of Grandeur
memory.description: For the rest of the run, the Debt to reach is 2x bigger. If you manage to open the door you'll get a Golden Knob for your Slot Machine (unless you already have it).
memory.dialogue: You really are delusional!

memory.name: Important Choice
memory.description: For the rest of the run, picking the "Most Spins" option at the Slot Machine doubles the 666 chances for that round. Picking the "Fewer Spins" option halves the 666 chances for that round instead.
memory.dialogue: You only made one or two of those, right?

memory.name: Recovery Attempts
memory.description: For the rest of the run, 666 has double the chances to show up. Whenever you hit a Jackpot you recover all coins you lost to the 666 in that same round.
memory.dialogue: Many failed attempts I'd say!

memory.name: Life Lessons
memory.description: For the rest of the run, whenever a Deadline ends, add the Devious Trait (+0.6% chance of seeing a 666) to a random Charm on the table. Then apply a random Trait to a random Charm inside a Drawer.
memory.dialogue: Haven't you learned your lesson yet?

memory.name: A New Investment
memory.description: For the rest of the run: +2% Interest at the end of every Deadline (Max 16%). You'll earn Coins [Coins] from your Interest only when a Deadline ends.
memory.dialogue: Did it bring anything in?

memory.name: Sacrifices
memory.description: You'll start with only 6 lucky Charms' spaces, but the store will have a permanent discount of 1 on every Charm for the rest of the run.
memory.dialogue: We all make sacrifices.

memory.name: Let's Go Gambling
memory.description: For the rest of the run, whenever a Deadline ends, 50% chance to discard all Charms in all Drawers, or apply a random Trait to them all.
memory.dialogue: At least you can gamble in here! Am I right?

memory.name: Class Dunce
memory.description: Immediately halves the chances of 2 random Symbols. Then begin the run.
memory.dialogue: You are still under exam!

memory.name: Heartbreak
memory.description: From the third Deadline onwards, the last Round of every Deadline has at least one 666 guaranteed to show up.
memory.dialogue: Oh, poor thing!

memory.name: Repressed Emotions
memory.description: Some predefined Charms will be banned for the rest of the run. You'll be able to check the terminal to see which ones.
memory.dialogue: We don't need to talk about those!

memory.name: First Love
memory.description: For the rest of the run, Phone abilities will trigger one more time, but whenever a Deadline starts the Store will be empty.
memory.dialogue: Bittersweet, isn't it?

memory.name: Expensive Love
memory.description: For the rest of the run, all Charms in the store have a random Trait (those compatible). You begin the run with 4 [Tickets]
memory.dialogue: Not much of a love story, was it?

memory.name: Overdose
memory.description: For the rest of the run, Lucky Charms triggered by the Red Button [Red Button] will trigger one more time, but they won't recharge whenever a round ends.
memory.dialogue: Saved just in time!

memory.name: Living on the Edge
memory.description: You can only deposit after the last round of every Deadline.
memory.dialogue: You are always looking for that thrill, aren't you?

memory.name: Stuck in a Routine
memory.description: Store can only spawn 1 box of Sardines. Sardines always spawn as modified in the Store. You begin the run with the Skull and the Red Pepper already equipped.

memory.name: Dangerous Experiments
memory.description: After paying for a Surgery, you get your coins back.
memory.dialogue: I take no responsibility for that!

memory.name: Bright Outside Dark Inside
memory.description: Charms spawned in the Store or in drawers cannot spawn as modified. All the other spawning method grant the Charm to have a random modification.
memory.dialogue: I can see behind your mask! Don't worry!

memory.name: Consequences
memory.description: All Charms always cost 1 Clover Ticket [Tickets]. Every time you buy a Charm, 50% chance to increase the cost by 1.
memory.dialogue: Fool around and find out!

memory.name: Herd Mentality

memory.dialogue: Identity. Critical thinking. Ever heard of those before?

memory.name: Vicious Cycle

memory.dialogue: It never ends, does it?
